decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty, Griselbrand, and Atraxa, Grand Unifier using cards like Faithless Looting, Thoughtseize, and Entomb. The combo then involves using spells like Reanimate, Animate Dead, and Exhume to bring these creatures back onto the battlefield for a devastating attack. Supporting cards like Dark Ritual, Lotus Petal, and Vexing Bauble are used to accelerate the process. This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful, reanimated creatures while disrupting their game plan with hand disruption spells.

This Mono Black Aggro deck focuses on quickly disrupting opponents with hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and aggressive creatures like Nethergoyf and Orcish Bowmasters. It also utilizes graveyard recursion with cards like Reanimate and Dauthi Voidwalker to maintain a constant pressure on the opponent. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells such as Fatal Push and Go for the Throat while building a strong board presence with creatures like Troll of Khazad-dûm. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with efficient threats and disruption.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game through a combination of board wipes, removal spells, counterspells, and card draw. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while efficiently advancing its own game plan. It utilizes powerful control elements such as Force of Will, Swords to Plowshares, and Terminus to handle threats, while cards like Brainstorm, Ponder, and Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath help maintain card advantage and ensure consistency. Additionally, the deck includes niche cards like Leyline Binding and Endurance to disrupt specific strategies and protect its own game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan with early counterspells and removal spells while quickly deploying threats like Reanimate and Animate Dead to apply pressure and close out the game. The inclusion of cards like Dauti Voidwalker and Grief further disrupts the opponent's hand and resources, while cards like Brainstorm and Ponder help smooth out draws and find key combo pieces. With a mix of control elements and aggressive creatures, this Dimir Tempo deck aims to tempo out opponents and win through efficient plays and powerful interactions.

The key concept of this deck is to utilize ramp from Cloudpost and Tron lands to quickly generate large amounts of mana and cast powerful threats like Karn, the Great Creator, Emrakul, and Ulamog. The deck also focuses on controlling the board with cards like Disruptor Flute and Bojuka Bog, while utilizing unique cards such as Planar Nexus and The Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of Sowing Mycospawn and Crop Rotation allows for further flexibility and synergy within the deck.

The core idea of this deck is to quickly assemble and execute a game-winning combo by milling your entire library and putting Thassa's Oracle onto the battlefield to win the game on the spot. The deck is built around utilizing fast mana acceleration, efficient graveyard enablers, and disruptive spells to ensure the combo can be executed as early as possible while protecting it from disruption with Pact of Negation. The main focus is on speed, efficiency, and consistency in executing the combo to secure a swift victory.

The deck focuses on quickly filling your graveyard with powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, and then bringing them back into play with spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead. The deck also includes disruption in the form of counterspells like Force of Will and Daze, and card filtering with spells like Brainstorm and Ponder. The goal is to overwhelm your opponent with powerful creatures while disrupting their game plan, ultimately winning the game through a strong graveyard-based strategy.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly bring powerful creatures back from the graveyard to the battlefield using cards like Reanimate and Animate Dead. By utilizing cards like Grief and Archon of Cruelty, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy and gain a significant advantage. The deck also includes counterspells like Force of Will and Daze to protect its combo pieces. Overall, the deck focuses on creating a strong board presence and controlling the game through its reanimation abilities and disruptive spells.

The main concept of this Combo - Reanimator deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, then use cards like Reanimate, Animate Dead, and Entomb to bring them back onto the battlefield for a fast and powerful offense. The deck also includes disruption spells like Force of Will and Daze to protect your combo pieces and control the game. Additionally, Brainstorm and Ponder help to dig through the deck and find the necessary pieces while cards like Misty Rainforest and Polluted Delta provide mana fixing and card selection.

The main concept of this UWx Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan with counterspells like Force of Will and Daze, removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending, and card advantage through Brainstorm and Teferi, Time Raveler. The deck also aims to stabilize the board with creatures like Murktide Regent and Orcish Bowmasters while controlling the opponent's resources. The deck is designed to control the game and outvalue the opponent in the long run, utilizing powerful spells and efficient threats to secure victory.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier using cards like Entomb and Grief, then bringing them back onto the battlefield using cards like Reanimate and Animate Dead. This combo strategy aims to overwhelm the opponent with big threats early in the game while also disrupting their plans with counterspells like Daze and Force of Will. The deck also includes some versatile creatures like Brazen Borrower and Troll of Khazad-dûm to provide additional options and support the overall game plan.

The deck focuses on assembling the Cephalid Breakfast combo using cards like Cephalid Illusionist and Nomads en-Kor to mill the library and put Narcomoeba in the graveyard. Dread Return is then used to reanimate Thassa's Oracle for the win. The deck also includes control elements like Teferi, Time Raveler and Force of Will to protect the combo, and Stoneforge Mystic to search for key equipment like Shuko and Sword of Kaldra. Additionally, it includes cards like Lórien Revealed to provide card advantage and Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion for additional value.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures like Grief and Archon of Cruelty, then use cards like Animate Dead and Reanimate to bring them back onto the battlefield for a huge advantage. The deck also utilizes counterspells like Force of Will and Daze to protect its game plan, and cards like Brainstorm and Ponder to find the combo pieces needed. By combining fast graveyard filling with graveyard recursion, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and disrupt their game plan.

The deck focuses on utilizing control cards to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while also utilizing the synergy between Stifle and Phyrexian Dreadnought to create a powerful win condition. By strategically countering and removing threats with cards like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares, the deck aims to control the game until it can assemble the Dreadnought combo to quickly finish off the opponent. Additionally, the deck can dig for key cards with Ponder and Brainstorm, while also utilizing Daze and Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's mana base.

This deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with creatures like Grief and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, then reanimating them with cards like Reanimate and Animate Dead. Using powerful combos and disruption spells like Force of Will and Daze, it aims to overwhelm the opponent with strong creatures and control the board with cards like Brazen Borrower and Archon of Cruelty. The key strategy is to efficiently utilize reanimation spells and disruption to quickly establish a dominant board presence and win the game.

The deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with powerful creatures, such as Troll of Khazad-dûm and Archon of Cruelty, and then bringing them back into play with cards like Animate Dead and Reanimate. It includes disruptive elements like Daze and Force of Will to protect the combo pieces, as well as card draw and filtering with Ponder and Brainstorm. The deck also utilizes land disruption with Wasteland and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to control the opponent's resources. Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Grief provide additional value and disruption to the strategy.
